property_summary: If the call to caddress succeeds for every recipient in the _tos array then the reference contract returns true on any call with a non-empty _tos array; the mutant reverts when _tos has exactly one element even if the caddress call would have succeeded.
change_summary: Replace `require(_tos.length > 0);` with `require(_tos.length > 1);` so calls with exactly one recipient revert instead of succeeding.
